since_last_build_verification.summary: 164 commits landed in the window; 33 new scripts + 7 new workflows. Of the 33 new scripts, 12 (36%) already have no runner and no manual-only declaration. Measured with scripts/ci/check_unwired_artifacts.py and spot-verified by hand on two samples.

classes.class: Built and never wired — a capability ships, nothing runs it
classes.structural_fix: check_unwired_artifacts.py exists and finds these. Promote it from advisory to a diff-scoped BLOCKING guard on newly added scripts/ and src/ modules, so a new tool cannot merge without either a runner or a '# wiring: manual-only' declaration. That retires the class instead of catching instances.

classes.class: Written but never read — a field is persisted and no consumer branches on it
classes.structural_fix: provenance-consumer-guard already enforces this for declared provenance keys. Widen its CONTRACTS table to cover any column a writer adds to the journal or registry, so writer-without-reader fails CI at the point of writing.

classes.class: Collapsed state — 'we did not look' is indistinguishable from 'we looked and found nothing'
classes.structural_fix: collapsed-state-guard exists with a CONTRACTS table. The class persists because registration is opt-in. Make registration mandatory for any new field whose value set includes a null or a zero that could mean either state.

classes.class: Alarm that cannot fire, or fires always
classes.structural_fix: Every alert needs a proof-of-life test that asserts it fires on a synthetic positive, in the same suite as the fix. test_merge_slot_guard.py is the pattern to copy fleet-wide.

classes.class: Provenance decay — the measured share of the scoreboard is falling
classes.structural_fix: Publish pnlCoverage as a first-class watched metric with a floor, and alert on the DERIVATIVE (coverage falling window over window), not the level — the level was never breached while coverage went 0.37 -> 0.06.

classes.class: Exit does not happen the way the strategy declares
classes.structural_fix: Make close_reason a first-class KPI on /api/bot/performance so '8.1% of closes used a declared bracket' is a number on the dashboard rather than something a review has to go and compute.

Convert every shared single-file relay trigger to a per-request directory (automation/<relay>-requests/<id>.json), which three sibling relays already do. It closes both the conflict mode and the inheritance mode at once.
